mechanism: Etanercept (TNF-alpha inhibitor) increases infection risk and may potentiate aminoglycoside nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity through combined immunosuppression and direct renal effects.
action: Monitor renal function closely, assess aminoglycoside levels, ensure adequate hydration, and consider alternative antibiotics if possible; use amikacin only when benefits outweigh risks in immunosuppressed patients.
